title: Kimi to Nara, Ashita wo Utaeru no
titleRomaji: Kimi to Nara, Ashita wo Utaeru no
titleNative: 君となら、明日を歌えるの
synonyms: With You, I Can Sing About Tomorrow
synopsis: That day, when I met you, my world, where I couldn't even speak, was filled with music. High school student Fujieda Yuzuki is a kind girl who is liked by everyone. She prioritizes the people around her - her friends and her boyfriend - and hides her true feelings. She's not good at using her own voice. Putting others first had been Yuzuki's way of life up until then. That is, until she met you. One day, Yuzuki comes across a girl singing and playing the guitar on the street. Unable to forget the voice, she was humming a tune alone in the classroom after school when the girl from that time, Terada Hinata, appeared. It turned out to be a student at the same high school. What's more, she spoke to him, saying, "I've come from the future to save you" --!? A girl meets girl x school youth story!! (Source: Young Ace Up, translated)

synopsis: In the beginning, this place was filled with someone's memories—sad memories. synopsis: Meet “the Killing Machine” Owaru Endou: the cold-blooded and strongest hitman of a massive underworld organization, who has decided to retire out of the blue. His reason? Can Owaru truly shed his identity to live the ultimate fan life of concerts, meet and greets, and picture lotteries—even when his past comes knocking? (Source: Yen Press)

synonyms: Jin: Legend of the Dipper Style Destruction King
synopsis: In the not-too-distant future... In a society where corruption has spread and dreams and hopes have disappeared, an illegal, no-rules underground fighting sport called "Yaoyorozu" has thrived. Brutal street fights are waged anywhere and everywhere, driven by money and human desire. Jin Matsuya, a delinquent who repeatedly steals from the city, gets caught up in the violence. However, his qualities as a fighter are overwhelming... A new generation of spectacular battle action begins, where an extraordinary monster destroys everything! (Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Painting Warriors
synopsis: In the early Song Dynasty (AD 960-1127), at the western border of the Tangut Empire - a pivot point of the Silk Road - furious battles were being fought. Brave warriors of the Tangut and a strange religious army from the west battled for a rumoured sacred item. Conflicts, conspiracies, and religious struggles - moving in the heart of the battlefield, the "untouchable war painter" Tao Hui paints nothing but the truth!

title: A Prince of a Friend
synopsis: Every girl Rui crushes on confesses to his best friend instead. But can you blame them? His buddy Mia may be a beautiful girl, but she has the bearing and personality of a shojo manga prince, which drives the other girls wild. When Rui can't break his heartbreak cycle on his own, Mia offers to train Rui in the art of romance...by becoming his practice partner. But with Mia whispering sweet nothings and blushing at every touch, it's starting to feel like she's the one getting swept off her feet. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

我和班上第二可愛的女生成為朋友
synopsis: Maki Maehara is always on his own at school. He has no friends or hobbies others share, and he doesn't expect the upcoming academic year to be any different, even surrounded by new faces. And six months later, it seems like he was right-until he runs into his popular classmate Umi Asanagi at a video store! Always at the center of attention and called the "second prettiest in class" by the boys, Asanagi's from a totally different world. But it turns out the two have more overlapping interests than just the B-grade movies they came to check out...and Asanagi asks Maehara to be her friend! (Source: Yen Press)
